firstPlayerRule: Each player rolls one die. Whoever rolls the higher number takes the first turn, using both numbers from that opening roll without rolling again.
officialTieBreak: If the opening dice match, both players roll again until their numbers differ.
clarifications: After the opening turn, the players alternate turns and each rolls two dice. The opening turn cannot be doubles because matching opening numbers are rerolled.
The optional automatic-doubles rule changes the stake when the opening dice match; it does not choose a starter. The source says players commonly agree to a maximum of one automatic double per game.
The source excludes automatic doubles, beavers and the Jacoby rule from match play.
